blocks.title: Reflection on AI supported judgment
paragraphs:
The most important AI-supported contribution to my analysis was
Organizing the company comparison, marketing alternatives and Human–AI workflow, and making financial assumptions easier to question. The source review helps separate company facts from proposed improvements.

The most important AI error limitation or unsupported output I found was
A confident source citation or calculation can look stronger than its evidence. Tiffany service pages do not prove an AI/AR system; rounded revenues do not justify an exact growth claim; proposed targets are not measured results.

What I changed in my recommendation after verification
The final Deck prioritizes verified catalogue data and human-reviewed bilingual AI descriptions, then makes opt-in AR conditional on consent, visual QA and a fair experiment. I would scale only after the measured incremental contribution exceeds fully loaded cost.

What remains uncertain before committing to the recommendation
The original financial statement, measured conversion/return baselines, vendor quotes, contribution per order, test traffic and sample size, legal review, full media attribution and approval of the proposed roadmap. I still need to complete personal verification before signing.
